test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

River rafting is an adventure sport in which a group of five people **__levitate through a river__** in an inflatable raft.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option(4) i.e. "navigate through a river".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Navigate" **correctly implies controlling or directing**(नियंत्रण या निर्देशन करना)** the path of the raft on the river, which fits the context of river rafting.
 
• **Levitate: (तैरना)** - The phenomenon of rising or causing something to rise and float in the air.
 
• Levitate **does not accurately **describe the action of moving through river waters in rafting.

**Therefore, the correct sentence is- *"River rafting is an adventure sport in which a group of five people navigate through a river__ in an inflatable raft."***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1** is incorrect because "deviate" means to turn away from a set course, which doesn't fit the intended meaning.
 
• **Option 2** "assemble" refers to bringing things or people together, not moving through water.
 
• **Option 3** "alleviate" means to make something less severe, which is irrelevant here.
